title: $\pi$-CoT: Prolog-Initialized Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Multi-Hop Question-Answering
abstract: arXiv:2506.20642v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting significantly enhances large language models' (LLMs) problem-solving capabilities, but still struggles with complex multi-hop questions, often falling into circular reasoning patterns or deviating from the logical path entirely. This limitation is particularly acute in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) settings, where obtaining the right context is critical. We introduce Prolog-Initialized Chain-of-Thought ($\pi$-CoT), a novel prompting strategy that combines logic programming's structural rigor with language models' flexibility. $\pi$-CoT reformulates multi-hop questions into Prolog queries decomposed as single-hop sub-queries. These are resolved sequentially, producing intermediate artifacts, with which we initialize the subsequent CoT reasoning procedure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that $\pi$-CoT matches or outperforms standard RAG and in-context CoT on multi-hop question-answering benchm

translated_title: π-CoT：用于多跳问答的Prolog初始化思维链提示方法
translated_abstract: 思维链（CoT）提示显著增强了大型语言模型（LLM）的问题解决能力，但在处理复杂的多跳问题时仍然存在困难，常常陷入循环推理模式或完全偏离逻辑路径。这一局限性在检索增强生成（RAG）场景中尤为突出，因为获取正确的上下文至关重要。我们提出了Prolog初始化思维链（π-CoT），这是一种新颖的提示策略，将逻辑编程的结构严谨性与语言模型的灵活性相结合。π-CoT将多跳问题重新表述为分解为单跳子查询的Prolog查询。这些子查询被依次求解，产生中间结果，我们利用这些中间结果来初始化后续的CoT推理过程。大量实验表明，π-CoT在多跳问答基准测试中达到或超越了标准RAG和上下文内CoT的性能。
tldr: π-CoT将多跳问题转化为Prolog查询并分解为单跳子查询依次求解，再利用中间结果初始化思维链推理，从而在多跳问答任务上达到或超越标准RAG和传统CoT方法的表现。
en_tdlr: π-CoT reformulates multi-hop questions into Prolog queries decomposed into single-hop sub-queries, resolves them sequentially, and initializes chain-of-thought reasoning with the intermediate results, matching or outperforming standard RAG and in-context CoT on multi-hop question-answering benchmarks.
